subject: Does the automated EGamersWorld fallback actually produce a pick?
method: Replay scripts.originate.run() on a throwaway copy of data/ holding one active fixture (Hotspawn 1082858 Ground Zero vs Off Chops), the reviewed alias registry, one saved EGamersWorld index anchor (3.44 / 1.24) and the request manifest entry that proves the fetch. No network access, no hand-entered probability.

saved_source.note: The same pair the previous session recorded from EGW on 2026-10-24 (data/research/43110640/unresolved-guided-picks.json).

before_this_session.reason: egw_live was never imported (NameError, swallowed) and the capture file was never read by reference_odds.load(); the reference rung saw an empty pool.
before_this_session.reproduced_by: reference_odds.CAPTURE_PATHS limited to the three hand-reviewed captures

after_this_session.gate: reference_odds.quote(): identity, exact start, freshness under 8 h, non-identical odds, no_vig margin band, excerpt SHA-256

fail_closed_cases_proved: request manifest missing -> entry rejected, nothing priced
manifest request status != ok -> entry rejected
manifest observation instant differs from the entry -> entry rejected as unwitnessed
quote whose source_url/observed_at/excerpt_sha256 match no capture -> audit finds no entry
